# package osport

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2/osport"
```

Package osport opens an l2.Port on a network interface with the backend of the operating system: AF\_PACKET on Linux (package l2/afpacket), BPF on macOS and the BSDs (package l2/bpf) and Npcap on Windows (package l2/npcap). See each backend for the privileges it needs.

